name: Omaspaces
author: Daniel Lobo
description: Hyprland workspace pills with clickable app icons, workspace names, scratchpad pills, and profiles that relaunch your app layout.

barWidget.description: Workspace pills with clickable app icons. Right-click an icon to move or close its window, right-click a number to rename the workspace, and use the profiles button to save and restore app layouts.

schema.label: Show app icons
schema.description: Show an icon for each open window.

schema.label: Icon style
schema.description: App uses each app's own icon, falling back to a glyph. Glyph uses Nerd Font glyphs and your icon rules.

schema.label: Show workspace numbers
schema.description: Show workspace numbers. Empty workspaces always show theirs.

schema.label: Base workspace count
schema.description: Workspaces always shown, even when empty.

schema.label: Highest workspace shown
schema.description: Highest workspace shown once it has windows.

schema.label: Hide empty extra workspaces
schema.description: Hide empty workspaces above the base count instead of dimming them.

schema.label: Max icons per workspace
schema.description: Icons per pill before the rest collapse into +N.

schema.label: Active color
schema.description: Color of the active workspace highlight.

schema.label: Custom icon rules file
schema.description: JSON file of {"match": "regex", "icon": "glyph"} rules, checked before the built-in ones. Edit it from the bar by right-clicking an app icon. Supports ~ and $HOME.

schema.label: Show special workspaces
schema.description: Show a pill for each special workspace that holds windows. Click it to show or hide that workspace.

schema.label: Show profiles button
schema.description: Show the button that opens workspace profiles.

schema.label: Workspace names
schema.description: Workspace names by id, e.g. {"1": "dev"}. Right-click a workspace number to edit.

schema.label: Profiles file
schema.description: JSON file where profiles are stored. Supports ~ and $HOME.
